hunks.baseline: The defenders at the backs of the collapsed walls fought more fiercely and more valiantly than ever.
hunks.sol: With the collapsed walls at their backs, the defenders fought more fiercely and more valiantly than ever.

hunks.baseline: After surviving against impossible odds and retreating to the Inner City, they numbered a little over five thousand.
hunks.sol: After surviving against impossible odds and retreating to the Inner City, they numbered around five thousand.

hunks.baseline: Compared to the tens of thousands of fanatics blackening the land on every side, the gap was so vast that *a mere handful* seemed an apt description. Yet the last-ditch defenders who stood against them didn’t give an inch.
hunks.sol: Compared to the tens of thousands of fanatics blackening the land on every side, they were a mere handful. Yet the last-ditch defenders didn’t give an inch.

hunks.baseline: But even if there was nowhere left to retreat, that didn’t mean they could advance.
hunks.sol: But having nowhere left to retreat didn’t mean they could advance.

hunks.baseline: Flesh split, revealing white bone. Amid the red mist that swirled over the battlefield at the moment of impact, anguished screams and shouts rang out, muffled and dull.
hunks.sol: Flesh split, revealing white bone. In the red mist that engulfed the battlefield as the two sides collided, screams of pain and shouted orders rang out, strangely muffled.

hunks.baseline: Stab!

hunks.baseline: The man who crumpled to the ground had been a Peak master renowned as a hero of Qinghai for decades. But in this horrific melee, amid all this death, none of that meant anything.
hunks.sol: The man who crumpled had been a Peak master renowned as a hero throughout Qinghai for decades. But in this horrific melee, amid all this death, none of that meant anything.

hunks.baseline: The Sect Leader of a school. The Family Head of a household surrounded by relatives.
hunks.sol: The Sect Leader of a school. A Family Head with a household to look after. A young man who had barely grown out of childhood.

hunks.baseline: A young man whose downy cheeks hadn’t even lost their softness.
The moment the fanatics’ blind blades swept them up, they became nothing more than lumps of meat, collapsing to the ground.
hunks.sol: The moment the fanatics’ blind blades swept them up, they fell as nothing more than lumps of meat.

hunks.baseline: The exhaustion crushing the defenders had long since gone far beyond its limit.
hunks.sol: The defenders had long since pushed past the limits of exhaustion.

hunks.baseline: Their remaining energy. The number of soldiers.
hunks.sol: The energy they had left. Their numbers.

hunks.baseline: They were short on everything. Desperately short.
hunks.sol: They lacked everything. Desperately.

hunks.baseline: The dead rolled limply across the ground. Those still alive could only tremble on instinct as they watched the advancing enemy trample over the bodies of their fallen comrades.
hunks.sol: The dead rolled limply across the ground. Those still alive could only tremble as they watched the advancing enemy trample the bodies of their fallen comrades.

hunks.baseline: They felt fear and anger, along with the helplessness of being unable to do anything.
hunks.sol: Fear and anger gripped them, along with the helplessness of being unable to do anything.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps that was why.
When their bodies, their hearts, the whole world around them seemed to sink into pitch-black darkness—
hunks.sol: Perhaps that was why, as their bodies and hearts—and the whole world around them—seemed to sink into pitch-black darkness, the flame someone kindled shone all the brighter.

hunks.baseline: A flame kindled by someone shone all the brighter.
At the heart of the fierce flames, surging forward in waves, stood a giant of fire, his burning eyes flashing.
hunks.sol: At the heart of the fierce flames surging forward stood a giant of fire, his burning eyes flashing.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang had always referred to himself as “this old man,” but not this time.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang had always called himself “this old man,” but not this time.

hunks.baseline: Along the perilous, steep path to the brink of death that Jeok Cheongang had always been forced to walk alone, there was now someone at his side—a man who had become both a part of him and his whole world.
hunks.sol: On the perilous, steep path toward death that Jeok Cheongang had always been forced to walk alone, there was now someone at his side—someone who had become both a part of him and his whole world.

hunks.baseline: Supporting Jin Taekyung’s unsteady frame as he burned the enemies rushing in from every direction, Jeok Cheongang shouted with all his might.
hunks.sol: Supporting Jin Taekyung as he staggered, Jeok Cheongang burned the enemies rushing in from every direction and shouted with all his might.

hunks.baseline: The blades he’d normally have scoffed at and dodged grazed his body. Every time he summoned his internal energy, tangled acupoints sent pain blazing through him. But none of that mattered to him now.
hunks.sol: Blades he would normally have scoffed at and dodged grazed his body. Every time he summoned his internal energy, pain blazed through his tangled acupoints. None of that mattered to him now.

hunks.baseline: But the old Master couldn’t refuse his Disciple, already standing at death’s door.
hunks.sol: But the old Master couldn’t refuse a Disciple already standing at death’s door.

hunks.baseline: And this wasn’t the will of Jeok Cheongang alone.
hunks.sol: And Jeok Cheongang wasn’t the only one willing to grant it.

hunks.baseline: Dozens of heads shot into the air in a dazzling flash.
hunks.sol: Dozens of heads flew into the air in a dazzling flash.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang swallowed the blood that suddenly surged into his mouth, then watched the sight with a faint smile.
hunks.sol: Jeok Cheongang swallowed the blood that suddenly surged into his mouth and watched with a faint smile.

hunks.baseline: He, too, had suffered serious injuries while fighting to hold back the Grand Mage and the Black Ghosts during the retreat to the Inner City.
hunks.sol: He, too, had suffered serious injuries fighting to hold back the Grand Mage and the Black Ghosts during the retreat to the Inner City.

hunks.baseline: His strike was as swift and precise as a ghost. The fanatics rushing in to fill the momentary gap crumpled like bundles of straw.
hunks.sol: The strike was ghostly in its speed and precision. The fanatics rushing in to fill the momentary gap crumpled like bundles of straw.

hunks.baseline: Just as his heart had crumpled when he saw Taekyung’s condition.
hunks.sol: Just as his heart had when he saw Taekyung’s condition.

hunks.baseline: Perhaps the man could escape this battlefield right now.
hunks.sol: Perhaps the man could escape this battlefield right now. He was the greatest assassin of all time.

hunks.baseline: And even as they stood there, that flame was slowly growing larger and hotter.

hunks.sol: The roar was so immense it shook even eardrums that had already burst. It sounded desperate, almost fierce with defiance.

hunks.baseline: Everyone who turned to find its source could only stare, wide-eyed.
hunks.sol: Everyone who turned toward its source stared wide-eyed.

hunks.baseline: Jeok Cheongang and Cheongpung, wounded themselves, supporting Jin Taekyung as they fought off their enemies.

hunks.sol: And one man walking slowly toward them, an overwhelming aura pouring from him.

hunks.baseline: One man.
No, one monster.
hunks.sol: No—a monster.

hunks.baseline: The words trailed off before they could be finished.
hunks.sol: His words trailed off.

hunks.sol: The Blood Lord stared toward the source of the roar, an indescribable look on his face. Then he burst into laughter.

hunks.sol: His booming laughter had no place on a battlefield covered in a sea of corpses and blood.
